text:
alex: CI red on main — integration suite against Hosted API failing. 6 tests failed, mostly auth 401s and streaming disconnects. cc @maria @raj @sophie
ci-bot: Build 12345 • tests/integration failed: test_auth_flow, test_streaming_tool_call_disconnect, test_tool_call_schema, test_tool_call_auth, test_streaming_partial_payload, test_schema_roundtrip
maria: Rerunning job now with DEBUG logs enabled. If it's auth-related maybe token rotated or header change.
raj: Noted — PR #981 changed SDK default header from X-Api-Key -> Authorization (Bearer). Could be callers still sending X-Api-Key and hosted-router recently tightened auth.
sophie: From local reproducer: streaming test shows `stream closed unexpectedly` after first chunk, and tool-call returns 400 with body: `{ "error": "schema mismatch", "details": "expected property 'tool_result'" }`.
alex: Can someone paste the raw HTTP response for one failing request? Need to see headers and auth type.
infraops: Looking at hosted logs — a token rotation happened at 01:15 UTC and there are a bunch of 401s from the CI runner ip range right after. We can temporarily accept legacy X-Api-Key for a rollback window.
jules: If this is a code change, we should bisect. Suggest bisecting main..main~30. I can spin up bisect job unless infra prefers to handle.
maria: Rerun returned same failures. Attached snippet from curl reproducer:
```
curl -v -H "X-Api-Key: $CI_KEY" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream
* HTTP/2 401
* {"error":"Unauthorized","message":"invalid api key"}
```
raj: That lines up with header swap. Tests should be updated to use AUTH header, but infra change caused break for older CI. For quick triage: 1) rerun with USE_LEGACY_AUTH=true to see if it passes, 2) infra to either re-enable legacy or provide migration window, 3) update tests/clients to send Authorization header.
sophie: For the streaming disconnect, logs show a 403 on websocket upgrade sometimes when using X-Api-Key. Might be router rejecting legacy header for ws.
alex: Action items — @infraops please enable legacy header for 2 hours; @jules start bisect if infra can't; @raj open quick PR to flip tests to Authorization header; @maria keep running reruns and post failing stack traces. If any test is noisy flank-mark it as flaky and skip until validated. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Rerun queued: job 12346 (with DEBUG).
infraops: Enabling legacy header acceptance now and monitoring. Will update in 5m.
maria: Updated — job 12346 passed auth checks but streaming still flaky (partial payload cut). Collecting full debug dump and will paste shortly.
alex: Thanks team — will keep this thread as the coordination channel. If the bisect finds PR 981 as culprit we revert and do a follow-up migration plan.
